items.title: Accor’s Largest Shareholder Moves to Oust CEO After Ennismore Buyout
items.snippet: Skift Take: Parvus, an activist investor, has criticized Accor's Ennismore buyout and 13 years of alleged stock price underperformance under CEO Sébastien Bazin. Accor's management has its own side to the story.

items.title: Peachtree Group acquires Home2 Suites by Hilton in Destin
items.snippet: ATLANTA – Peachtree Group ‘s latest investment includes the Home2 Suites Destin acquisition, adding 112 rooms to its hospitality portfolio. The property operates under the Home2 Suites by Hilton brand. It stands at 14060 Emerald Coast Parkway in Destin, Florida. The deal strengthens Peachtree’s presence in one of the Southeast’s established coastal tourism markets.

items.title: WTTC launches Ocean Catalyst Group at COP31
items.snippet: The World Travel & Tourism Council (WTTC), its members Iberostar Group and Intrepid Travel, and the Ocean & Climate Platform (OCP) have announced the creation of the Ocean Catalyst Group at COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye. Launched during COP31’s Ocean Day on November 18, 2026, the initiative aims to bring tourism businesses together to drive collective action to protect coastal destinations, communities and livelihoods.

items.title: IndiGo to launch Bengaluru to Hanoi & Darbhanga flights
items.snippet: IndiGo will launch daily direct flights connecting Bengaluru with Hanoi in Vietnam and Darbhanga in Bihar from December 20, 2026, the airline announced in a press release on Thursday. The new services are aimed at strengthening connectivity from Bengaluru, expanding the airline’s network across international and domestic markets.

items.title: Why the Hotel Website is More Important than Ever
items.snippet: As AI tools reshape travel discovery, hotel websites must balance visual appeal with structured, text-based content that AI systems like ChatGPT and Gemini can parse and cite.

items.title: IHCL’s growth is about returns and quality, not just hotel numbers: Puneet Chhatwal
items.snippet: The MD & CEO of the Indian Hotels Company Limited, outlined an ambitious growth agenda, saying his company was opening 50 hotels this financial year while positioning Taj as a global leader in luxury hospitality. He indicated that the company could achieve its 700-hotel target well ahead of its 2030 deadline, even as it focuses on returns, profitability and brand strength alongside expansion.

items.title: Above the Lagoon, Beneath the Sea – The world of You&Me Maldives
items.snippet: An adults-only island in the turquoise waters of the Indian Ocean offers a serene retreat for travellers seeking peace, privacy, and quiet. While the Maldives has no shortage of resorts, You&Me is one of the few resorts in the Maldives that offers the seclusion of an adults-only island with an underwater restaurant.

items.title: Blue gold: Hotels step up conservation
items.snippet: Water scarcity is emerging as a growing concern across India, with urban expansion, rising consumption, erratic rainfall patterns and mounting pressure on existing water infrastructure adding to the challenge. From metropolitan cities to rapidly developing urban centres, water availability is becoming an increasingly important concern for businesses, residential communities and industries.
